change: Twenty tools were consolidated into six action-based tools. get_decision maps to decision with the documented required action="get". SQLite schema and selected read results are unchanged.
limitations: Only decision retrieval is evaluated. The real consolidated decision contract also permits writes; fixture policy and independent SQLite state checks are therefore required.

Both historical getDecision implementations query v_tagged_decisions, whose definition includes only the string decision table. A stored numeric decision therefore returns found=false on both versions; the independent oracle preserves and documents that upstream limitation.
Historical console startup diagnostics are redirected to stderr by an external bootstrap to keep the real MCP stream valid; historical tool logic is unchanged.
setup: Unmodified historical source plus external synthetic-fixture bootstrap; no host mounts or network at runtime.
